holdout_designation: last origin = test; selection used origins 1..n-1 only
selection_rule: champion (best_model) = lowest pooled MAE over origins 1..n-1; all candidates are then scored exactly once on the test window and those are the committed headline metrics
preprocessing_statement: Feature engineering uses shift-only lags and deterministic calendar encodings (no statistic is estimated on future rows); every model, the ridge StandardScaler, the MASE seasonal denominator and the conformal calibration widths are fit within the training window of each fold; the test window is scored once and never read for selection

metric_definitions.mae: mean |actual - forecast| over the test window (all series pooled)
metric_definitions.rmse: root mean squared error over the test window
metric_definitions.mape_pct: mean absolute percentage error over non-zero actuals only, in % — inflated by near-zero demand on intermittent series; not decision-grade
metric_definitions.mase: MAE scaled by the per-series in-sample seasonal-naive-7 error of the test fold's training window; < 1 beats 'same day last week'
metric_definitions.bias: mean(forecast - actual) over the test window — systematic over- or under-forecasting
metric_definitions.wape: sum|actual - forecast| / sum|actual| over the test window (weighted absolute percentage error; null when the denominator is 0)
metric_definitions.fold_maes: per-fold pooled MAE, folds 1..n (fold n is the test window)
metric_definitions.fold_mae_std: population std of fold_maes across all folds
metric_definitions.fold_mae_range: max - min of fold_maes across all folds
metric_definitions.horizon_mae: per-horizon (h=1..14) mean |error| over the final 14 days of the test window, pooled over series
metric_definitions.horizon_mase: per-horizon (h=1..14) mean |error|/seasonal scale over the final 14 days of the test window
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_mae: pre-holdout headline: pooled MAE over ALL folds (selection + test), kept for comparison
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_rmse: pre-holdout headline: pooled RMSE over all folds
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_mape_pct: pre-holdout headline: pooled MAPE over all folds
metric_definitions.legacy_pooled_mase: pre-holdout headline: pooled MASE over all folds

multi_horizon.track: multi_step (primary); the top-level rolling_origin_holdout_v1 keys describe the retained frozen nowcast track

origins.cap_note: weekly origins, capped at 20 by dropping the oldest (exact weekly cadence kept) for runtime; the window starts the day AFTER the origin (no embargo gap)

multi_horizon.holdout_designation: last 4 origins = test (scored once); the earlier origins select (routing + conformal calibration) only
multi_horizon.selection_rule: per-series routing method = lowest summed |error| over the selection origins: sparse series among zero/seasonal_naive/Croston/SBA/TSB/hgb_tweedie/hurdle_hgb (direct_hgb ineligible — the wave-19 sparse finding); smooth/erratic series among direct_hgb/hgb_tweedie/hurdle_hgb; never reads test actuals (property-tested by shuffling the test origins' actuals)
multi_horizon.feature_semantics: direct per-horizon models: calendar of the target date + peak block at target-h (rolling mean/max over 7/14/28d windows ending at target-h, days-since-last-nonzero, 28d non-zero-day count, 28d peak ratio) + lags lag_h, lag_{h+7}, lag_{h+14} (every feature >= h days old relative to the target — no actual within h days of the target is referenced); training rows use targets <= the origin only
multi_horizon.uncertainty: per-horizon split-conformal (learner rows and the peak-capable candidates' own point forecasts) and P(sale)+quantile ladder (sparse rows), both calibrated on selection origins

metric_definitions.mae: mean |actual - forecast| over series x scored test origins at horizon h
metric_definitions.mase: pooled |err| / pooled per-series in-sample seasonal-naive-7 scale (zero-scale rows excluded)
metric_definitions.rmsse: M5-style: per-series sqrt(MSE(err)/MSE(in-sample seasonal-naive-7)), averaged over series (zero-scale excluded)
metric_definitions.pinball_pXX: mean pinball loss of the learner quantile at level XX
metric_definitions.coverage: share of actuals inside the per-h band on the scored origins
metric_definitions.calibration_verdict: |coverage - target| <= 0.05 -> calibrated; above -> conservative; below -> optimistic
metric_definitions.peak_mae: per scored window (series x test origin), MAE on the window's top-decile-by-actual days of the scored h-lattice; pooled per class as the mean over windows
metric_definitions.peak_recall: per scored window, the share of the window's top-5 actual days whose day ranks in the forecast's own top-5; pooled per class as the mean over windows
